blocks.text: When a customer issue cannot be resolved by the L1 support agent within 30 minutes, it must be escalated to L2. The L1 agent should summarize the issue and hand it off.

L2 Support are senior agents with deeper product knowledge. They will attempt to replicate the issue. If it's a confirmed bug, L2 is responsible for creating a ticket in Jira for the engineering team.
Critical issues, defined as those impacting more than 50% of users or any financial data, must be escalated directly to the on-call engineer via PagerDuty by the L2 agent.
